commentary.text: 90+6' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes it short.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Callum Hudson-Odoi can be given a rest.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 30579.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Tottenham win a corner.

88' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the middle of the goal but is denied by Guglielmo Vicario, who pulls off a comfortable save!
86' A free kick on the edge of the box for Nottingham. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
85' Here comes a substitution. Igor Jesus is given a rest as he is replaced by Douglas Luiz (Nottingham).
84' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.
80' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) replacing Mohammed Kudus.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathys Tel (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch for Randal Kolo Muani.
79' 3 - 0 Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) latches on to an excellent pass just outside the box. He thunders the ball towards the right-hand post and it bounces in the back of the net.
74' Tottenham will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
73' 45:55 – the latest ball possession ratio.
70' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
70' John Victor (Nottingham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
69' John Victor (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
69' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
65' Handball by Xavi Simons (Tottenham).
63' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
61' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
59' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Archie Gray and he is replaced by Joao Palhinha (Tottenham).
59' Today's match ends for Djed Spence who will be replaced by Ben Davies (Tottenham).
58' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
54' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

50' 2 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Guglielmo Vicario just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:0.
49' The corner from Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario.
48' Djed Spence (Tottenham) tries to find Randal Kolo Muani, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Samuel Barrott stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
40' What was Archie Gray (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
40' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
37' Chance! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
36' Nottingham take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
34' A snap shot by Archie Gray (Tottenham) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but John Victor produces a good save to thwart him.
33' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
33' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
31' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! Guglielmo Vicario makes a huge mistake and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
25' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
23' The ball is cleared after Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' The game is interrupted now, Xavi Simons (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends a long ball forward to Nicolo Savona, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
15' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
13' It seemed like Pedro Porro (Tottenham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
12' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
8' A spell of possession for Tottenham in an attempt to control the game.

5' Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Neco Williams (Nottingham) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
5' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
4' Neco Williams (Nottingham) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will take a throw-in.
